youtube.title: OKX Invite Code: Same as a Referral Code?
youtube.description:
An OKX invite code is the code an existing user shares so a new user can link their account at sign-up. Invite code and referral code mean the same thing and go into the same field.

Referral code: XOACPQFC

Skip anyone selling VIP invite codes. VIP tiers follow OKX's own fee rules.

Updated: November 2026

Educational content only. Not financial advice. Independent channel, not affiliated with OKX; this channel may earn a referral commission if you use the code. Check that OKX is available in your country before signing up. The narration voice is AI-generated.
